_comment: Branch protection ruleset for the main branch. Applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh. Rules marked _staged:true represent target-state checks not yet ready to be managed from this checked-in config; apply-ruleset.sh and check-ruleset.yml filter them out of config-driven apply/drift checks for now, and any currently live rules of those staged types may be retained until the staged config is promoted. CI Gate cutover (LS-8014, stage 3 of LS-7988 / Phase 2 LS-7991): the granular 🚀 CI Pipeline / {lint,format,build,test,custom-checks,e2e-affected} required check-run names have been REMOVED from the required set — they are now folded into the single CI Gate aggregate commit status (see the CI Gate entry below and docs/ci-cd/ci-gate-aggregator.md). The granular jobs still run and post as informational check runs; they are simply no longer required. The cutover is live: this config was applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh and matches the live ruleset (confirmed as of 2026-07-06, docs/dev-process/ground-truth-audit-2026-07-07.md), so check-ruleset.yml reporting drift is NOT expected and should be investigated.
name: Protect Main

rules._comment: Prevent force pushes to main — history must be linear and immutable.
Prevent direct deletion of the main branch.

Require a pull request before merging into main. required_approving_review_count:0 is intentional — the merge gate is the bot-review required status check (commit status set by the Code Reviewer Bot), not GitHub's formal approving-review count. require_code_owner_review:true enforces .github/CODEOWNERS, requiring @bkrupa approval on sensitive paths (auth, payments, migrations, CI, terraform) — enabled in T17 (LS-3998). dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push:true ensures the bot's APPROVE is dismissed on every new push, forcing re-review of each HEAD SHA (LS-3977).

Require bot approval, conflict-free state, and passing CI before merging. After the LS-8014 cutover the CI signal is the single CI Gate aggregate commit status (see its entry below) — the granular '🚀 CI Pipeline / *' composite check-run names are no longer required. bot-review and CI Gate are commit statuses (not check runs) set via the GitHub Statuses API (bot-review by the Code Reviewer Bot, .github/scripts/reviewer/lib/github.mjs:setCommitStatus; CI Gate by .github/scripts/ci-gate.js). The _commitStatus and _calledWorkflow markers are stripped by apply-ruleset.sh before sending to the API. strict_required_status_checks_policy:false (LS-4183): the up-to-date-with-base sub-policy is intentionally disabled to allow merge-queue throughput. With strict=true the queue had to call pulls.updateBranch() on every behind PR, creating Merge-main commits and serializing all merges (~1 PR per CI cycle). Trade-off accepted: the rare semantic-conflict class (textually-disjoint PRs that combine to break main) is caught by post-merge CI on main rather than blocked pre-merge. Textual conflicts are still blocked unconditionally by mergeable:false.

required_status_checks._comment: Commit status set to pending/success/failure by the Code Reviewer Bot (.github/scripts/reviewer/index.mjs). Not a check run — no matching workflow job name.

Fails if the PR branch has merge conflicts with the base branch. Posted as a commit status (LS-9604) by check-conflicts.yml and check-conflicts-sweep.yml — not a check run, so it cannot accrue the cancelled-duplicate-name pile-up that a concurrency-cancelled check-run can (the same rationale as bot-review/CI Gate below). Not a check-run: no matching workflow job name.

Verifies all migration files in lib/db-client/migrations/ are applied to the production RDS before merge. Blocks PRs that add a migration file without running it first. Defined in check-migrations-applied.yml; runs on every PR (no paths filter) so this required check always fires. LS-4843. Posted as a commit status (LS-9776, mirrors LS-9604) by that workflow's 'check' job — not a check run, so it cannot accrue the cancelled-duplicate-name pile-up that a concurrency-cancelled check-run can, and so a workflow_dispatch manual retrigger (with a pr_number input) can post it too. Not a check-run: no matching workflow job name.

Aggregate CI Gate (LS-7991, Phase 2 of LS-7988; cutover completed in LS-8014). A single commit status posted once per head SHA by the CI Pipeline summarize job (.github/scripts/ci-gate.js), folding the granular lint/format/build/test/custom-checks/lockfile-check/e2e results. It REPLACES the 6 granular '🚀 CI Pipeline / {lint,format,build,test,custom-checks,e2e-affected}' required CHECK-RUN names — whose cancelled duplicates under concurrency cancellation 405'd genuinely-green PRs (the root cause in LS-7988) — with ONE unambiguous status context. A commit status is used (not a check run) because GitHub evaluates the latest status per context and has no 'cancelled' status state, so the duplicate-required-name ambiguity cannot recur. The granular jobs still run and post as INFORMATIONAL check runs; they are simply no longer required. e2e merge-gate semantics (formerly the separate '🚀 CI Pipeline / e2e-affected' required check, LS-7846 / docs/decisions/0012-pr-ci-e2e-coverage.md) are preserved inside this aggregate: CI Gate fails if any affected e2e shard fails. The cutover is live: this required set was applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh and matches the live ruleset (confirmed as of 2026-07-06, docs/dev-process/ground-truth-audit-2026-07-07.md), so check-ruleset.yml (a non-required drift check) should report no drift. Rollout + rollback: docs/ci-cd/ci-gate-aggregator.md.
